view.title: P2 — The repo you'll live in: six Maven modules, one deployable
view.caption: How is the new repository shaped? Six Maven modules, one bootable jar (ADR 0005, five-module reading ratified at PLAN-OK). Cluster modules may depend on spine-contracts only — the module-boundary rule wired CI-blocking in task zero; screening is a shared library, not a pipeline component. Opens SYS from P1.

omitted.label: architecture-tests
omitted.note: ArchUnit fitness functions F1–F4 + module-boundary + no-gateway-credential rules, CI-blocking from task zero (M18) — a build artifact, not a runtime module (not shown for brevity)

omitted.label: db/migration + ci/
omitted.note: Flyway V1 (lineage core + grants) and pipeline-as-code (runner pinned by digest — M28) land in task zero (not shown for brevity)

nodes.label: app
detail: Thin assembly; wiring only. The single deployable — mvn package yields exactly one bootable jar (ADR 0005)

nodes.label: conversion
detail: Packages: ingestion (Excel/POI + Octane REST adapters behind one contract — C1, with deterministic canonicalization + snapshot digest — M15), hierarchytool (capture, prune, pool identity — M24)
Ambiguous steps are flagged in the IR rather than silently resolved

nodes.label: validation-certification
detail: Packages: staticgate, devicegate (worker — holds no gateway credential, ADR 0013), classification (fixed 7-class taxonomy), replayreport, objectrepo (port + read-only stub — C5)

nodes.label: evidence
detail: Packages: lineage (append-only writes, principal, hash chain, supersede reads — ADR 0012), outbox+queue (ADR 0007), objectstorage (S3 port + MinIO adapter — ADR 0011), anchoring (job + verification), retention

nodes.label: spine-contracts
detail: The three schema contracts as Java records with Jackson: TestCaseIR, LocatorCandidate, ReplayReport
JSON Schema exported via victools and committed; drift between record and schema fails CI
PinnedValue marker enum {REAL, NOT_APPLICABLE, UNPINNABLE_PHASE1(reserved)} (C4/M12); corpusClass (M19); retentionClass (M39)

nodes.label: screening
detail: Shared library, not a pipeline component (ADR 0009): injection screening + secret/PII redaction; one-line in-process API, no network; versioned; red-team corpus + regression report (count / source mix / last addition / bypass rate — M36)
Flagged payloads quarantine for review; release is a recorded, attributable override (M35/M18)
